rule: Row ID, Item Number and Variation # never change. Item on COTT: COTT wording, link and code on the variations COTT has; extra variations stay, in our own words, linked to the COTT page. Item not on COTT: our own words, same facts; the Tandem link stays. The old cells are NOT reproduced here (they held Tandem Associates wording); each is identified by the sha256 of its exact old text. Keys: Row ID + sheet row + item number.
